mapper.select: SELECT bc.comment_id AS commentId, bc.board_id AS boardId, bc.member_id AS memberId, bc.content AS content, bc.created_at AS createdAt, bc.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.nickname AS nickname FROM board_comment bc JOIN shop_member m ON bc.member_id = m.member_id WHERE bc.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY bc.comment_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment ( comment_id, board_id, member_id, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( seq_board_comment.NEXTVAL, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
